answer_1.quote: We consider the abstractive document-to-slide generation task as a query-based single-document text summarization (QSS) task.
answer_1.outputs: abstractive summaries used as slide content

answer_2.quote: For slide text content generation, we use ROUGE as the automatic evaluation metric.

answer_4.quote: In addition to the automated evaluation, we also conducted a human evaluation to ask raters to evaluate the slides generated by BARTKeyword (our model), by baseline models (both BARTSumm and BertSummExt) based on Dense-Mix IR, and by the non-author human experts (Human).
answer_4.guideline: Participants rated slides using a 6-point Likert scale on three dimensions: Readability, Informativeness, and Consistency.
